### Description

Simple word cycling similar to [dial.nvim#constants](https://github.com/monaqa/dial.nvim?tab=readme-ov-file#constant).

```md
|In programming, **true** and **false** ...
```
```md
In programming, **|false** and **false** ...
                  ^ After `<Leader>c`
```

Configuration example:

```lua
vim.g.cycle_config = {
  { words = { "true", "false" } },
  { words = { "True", "False" }, pat = "%f[%u]()%f[%W]" },
  { words = { "left", "right" } },
  { words = { "and", "or" } },
  { words = { "get", "set" } },
  { words = { "&&", "||" }, pat = "()" },
  { words = { "yes", "no", "maybe" } },
  { words = { "on", "off" } },
  { words = { "stylua: ignore start", "stylua: ignore end", "stylua: ignore" }, pat = "()" },
  { words = { "start", "end" } },
}
```

### Advanced: `v:count` jump

```md
In programming, **true** and **|true** ...
                               ^ After `2<Leader>c`
```

A pattern built from all words in `vim.g.cycle_config` is searched using `search_method="cover_or_next"`. If a match is found, the corresponding cover pattern is searched using `search_method="cover"`. This second search is needed because **mini.ai** selects the shortest cover match.

<details><summary>Code (version 1)</summary>

>
```lua
vim.g.cycle_config = {
  { words = { "true", "false" } },
  { words = { "True", "False" }, pat = "%f[%u]()%f[%W]" },
  { words = { "left", "right" } },
  { words = { "and", "or" } },
  { words = { "get", "set" } },
  { words = { "&&", "||" }, pat = "()" },
  { words = { "yes", "no", "maybe" } },
  { words = { "on", "off" } },
  { words = { "stylua: ignore start", "stylua: ignore end", "stylua: ignore" }, pat = "()" },
  { words = { "start", "end" } },
}

local find_textobject = function(ai_type, spec, opts)
  opts = vim.tbl_extend("keep", opts or {}, { silent = true })
  local snap_config = vim.deepcopy(MiniAi.config)
  local tmp_id = "_"
  MiniAi.config = { custom_textobjects = { [tmp_id] = spec }, silent = opts.silent }
  local reg = MiniAi.find_textobject(ai_type, tmp_id, opts)
  MiniAi.config = snap_config
  return reg
end

local buf_get_text = function(reg)
  local from, to = reg.from, reg.to
  return vim.api.nvim_buf_get_text(0, from.line - 1, from.col - 1, to.line - 1, to.col, {})
end

local buf_set_text = function(reg, buf_text, follow)
  local from, to = reg.from, reg.to
  vim.api.nvim_buf_set_text(0, from.line - 1, from.col - 1, to.line - 1, to.col, buf_text)
  if follow then
    vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(0, { from.line, from.col - 1 })
  end
end

local function get_config()
  local config = {}
  vim.list_extend(config, vim.b.cycle_config or {})
  vim.list_extend(config, vim.g.cycle_config or {})
  for i, conf in ipairs(config) do
    conf = vim.tbl_extend("keep", conf, { words = {}, cycle = true, pat = "%f[%w]()%f[%W]" })
    conf._patterns = vim.tbl_map(function(word)
      local pat = conf.pat
      local word_pat, gc = pat:gsub("%(%)", word)
      return gc == 1 and word_pat or error(("[mini.cycle] Unable to substitute pattern: %s"):format(pat))
    end, conf.words)
    config[i] = conf
  end
  return config
end

local cycle_word = function()
  local config = get_config()
  local match_pattern = {}
  for _, conf in ipairs(config) do
    for i, word in ipairs(conf.words) do
      if word ~= "" then
        table.insert(match_pattern, conf._patterns[i])
      end
    end
  end
  local match_reg = find_textobject("a", { match_pattern }, {
    search_method = "cover_or_next",
    n_lines = 0,
    n_times = vim.v.count1,
  })
  if not match_reg then
    vim.notify("[mini.cycle] No matches found in the current line", vim.log.levels.WARN)
    return
  end
  local find_longest_cover = function(conf, ref_reg)
    local item_list = {}
    for i, word in ipairs(conf.words) do
      if word ~= "" then
        table.insert(item_list, { i = i, word = word, pat = conf._patterns[i] })
      end
    end
    table.sort(item_list, function(a, b)
      return #a.word >= #b.word
    end)
    for _, item in ipairs(item_list) do
      local cover_reg = find_textobject("a", { item.pat }, {
        search_method = "cover",
        n_lines = 0,
        n_times = 1,
        reference_region = { from = ref_reg },
      })
      if cover_reg then
        return cover_reg, item.i
      end
    end
  end
  local match_text = buf_get_text(match_reg)[1]
  for _, conf in ipairs(config) do
    if vim.list_contains(conf.words, match_text) then
      local cover_reg, i = find_longest_cover(conf, match_reg.from)
      if cover_reg then
        local next_index = conf.cycle and (i % #conf.words + 1) or math.min(i + 1, #conf.words)
        local next_word = conf.words[next_index]
        local cover_text = buf_get_text(cover_reg)[1]
        if next_word ~= cover_text then
          buf_set_text(cover_reg, { next_word }, true)
        end
        return
      end
    end
  end
end

vim.keymap.set("n", "<Leader>c", cycle_word, { desc = "Cycle" })
```

</details>

### Simple: `v:count` cycle

```lua
vim.g.cycle_config = {
  { words = { "yes", "no", "maybe" } },
}
```

```md
In programming, **|maybe**, **no**, **maybe** ...
                  ^ After `2<Leader>c`
```

<details><summary>Code (version 2)</summary>

>
```lua
vim.g.cycle_config = {
  { words = { "true", "false" } },
  { words = { "True", "False" }, pat = "%f[%u]()%f[%W]" },
  { words = { "left", "right" } },
  { words = { "and", "or" } },
  { words = { "get", "set" } },
  { words = { "&&", "||" }, pat = "()" },
  { words = { "yes", "no", "maybe" } },
  { words = { "on", "off" } },
  { words = { "stylua: ignore start", "stylua: ignore end", "stylua: ignore" }, pat = "()" },
  { words = { "start", "end" } },
}

local find_textobject = function(ai_type, spec, opts)
  opts = vim.tbl_extend("keep", opts or {}, { silent = true })
  local snap_config = vim.deepcopy(MiniAi.config)
  local tmp_id = "_"
  MiniAi.config = { custom_textobjects = { [tmp_id] = spec }, silent = opts.silent }
  local reg = MiniAi.find_textobject(ai_type, tmp_id, opts)
  MiniAi.config = snap_config
  return reg
end

local get_pattern = function(word, pat)
  local word_pat, gc = pat:gsub("%(%)", word)
  return gc == 1 and word_pat or error(("[mini.cycle] Unable to substitute pattern: %s"):format(pat))
end

local set_text = function(reg, buf_text)
  local from, to = reg.from, reg.to
  local reg_text = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_text(0, from.line - 1, from.col - 1, to.line - 1, to.col, {})
  if not vim.deep_equal(buf_text, reg_text) then
    vim.api.nvim_buf_set_text(0, from.line - 1, from.col - 1, to.line - 1, to.col, buf_text)
  end
  vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(0, { from.line, from.col - 1 })
end

local cycle_word = function()
  local config = {}
  vim.list_extend(config, vim.b.cycle_config or {})
  vim.list_extend(config, vim.g.cycle_config or {})
  local col = vim.api.nvim_win_get_cursor(0)[2] + 1
  local matches = {}
  for _, conf in ipairs(config) do
    conf = vim.tbl_extend("keep", conf, {
      words = {},
      cycle = true,
      pat = "%f[%w]()%f[%W]",
    })
    for i, word in ipairs(conf.words) do
      if word ~= "" then
        local reg = find_textobject("a", { get_pattern(word, conf.pat) }, {
          search_method = "cover_or_next",
          n_lines = 0,
          n_times = 1,
        })
        if reg and (conf.cycle or word ~= conf.words[#conf.words]) then
          table.insert(matches, { conf = conf, i = i, reg = reg })
        end
      end
    end
  end
  -- NOTE: Closest to the cursor
  table.sort(matches, function(a, b)
    return math.abs(a.reg.from.col - col) < math.abs(b.reg.from.col - col)
  end)
  local match = matches[1]
  if not match then
    vim.notify("[mini.cycle] No matches found in the current line", vim.log.levels.WARN)
    return
  end
  local conf, i = match.conf, match.i
  local next_index
  if vim.v.count ~= 0 then
    -- NOTE: No cycling, fixed value
    next_index = math.min(vim.v.count1, #conf.words)
  else
    next_index = conf.cycle and (i % #conf.words + 1) or math.min(i + 1, #conf.words)
  end
  local next_word = conf.words[next_index]
  set_text(match.reg, { next_word })
end

vim.keymap.set("n", "<Leader>c", cycle_word, { desc = "Cycle" })
```

</details>

        return
      end
    end
  end
end

  { words = { "true", "false" } },

  { words = { "yes", "no", "maybe" } },
  { words = { "on", "off" } },
  { words = { "stylua: ignore start", "stylua: ignore end", "stylua: ignore" }, pat = "()" },
  { words = { "start", "end" } },

local find_textobject = function(ai_type, spec, opts)
  opts = vim.tbl_extend("keep", opts or {}, { silent = true })
  local snap_config = vim.deepcopy(MiniAi.config)
  local tmp_id = "_"
  MiniAi.config = { custom_textobjects = { [tmp_id] = spec }, silent = opts.silent }
  local reg = MiniAi.find_textobject(ai_type, tmp_id, opts)
  MiniAi.config = snap_config
  return reg
end

local get_pattern = function(word, pat)
  local word_pat, gc = pat:gsub("%(%)", word)
  return gc == 1 and word_pat or error(("[mini.cycle] Unable to substitute pattern: %s"):format(pat))
end

local set_text = function(reg, buf_text)
  local from, to = reg.from, reg.to
  local reg_text = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_text(0, from.line - 1, from.col - 1, to.line - 1, to.col, {})
  if not vim.deep_equal(buf_text, reg_text) then
    vim.api.nvim_buf_set_text(0, from.line - 1, from.col - 1, to.line - 1, to.col, buf_text)
  end
  vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(0, { from.line, from.col - 1 })
end

local cycle_word = function()
  local config = {}
  vim.list_extend(config, vim.b.cycle_config or {})
  vim.list_extend(config, vim.g.cycle_config or {})
  local col = vim.api.nvim_win_get_cursor(0)[2] + 1
  local matches = {}
  for _, conf in ipairs(config) do
    conf = vim.tbl_extend("keep", conf, {
      words = {},
      cycle = true,
      pat = "%f[%w]()%f[%W]",
    })
    for i, word in ipairs(conf.words) do
      if word ~= "" then
        local reg = find_textobject("a", { get_pattern(word, conf.pat) }, {
          search_method = "cover_or_next",
          n_lines = 0,
          n_times = 1,
        })
        if reg and (conf.cycle or word ~= conf.words[#conf.words]) then
          table.insert(matches, { conf = conf, i = i, reg = reg })
        end
      end
    end
  end
  -- NOTE: Closest to the cursor
  table.sort(matches, function(a, b)
    return math.abs(a.reg.from.col - col) < math.abs(b.reg.from.col - col)
  end)
  local match = matches[1]
  if not match then
    vim.notify("[mini.cycle] No matches found in the current line", vim.log.levels.WARN)
    return
  end
  local conf, i = match.conf, match.i
  local next_index
  if vim.v.count ~= 0 then
    -- NOTE: No cycling, fixed value
    next_index = math.min(vim.v.count1, #conf.words)
  else
    next_index = conf.cycle and (i % #conf.words + 1) or math.min(i + 1, #conf.words)
  end
  local next_word = conf.words[next_index]
  set_text(match.reg, { next_word })
end

vim.keymap.set("n", "<Leader>c", cycle_word, { desc = "Cycle" })

> One small spoiler question: will the new module support treesitter in some way, or will it be pattern-only?

The current aspiration is for it to be at least flexible enough to handle tree-sitter regions. The main problem with it is that it would probably require custom queries, which is not great.

My long time reference for that module is "I want to be able to invert the `if` statement, however complex". Like `if a and b and (c or d) then` not just into `if not (a and b and (c or d)) then` (but even that is not bad), but into `if (not a) or (not b) or (not c and not d) then`. This might be too complex, though.
